title: Utah Senate President J. Stuart Adams, who championed a huge data center beside the Great Salt Lake, lost his Republican primary on Tuesday after voter backlash (Jack Healy/New York Times)
summary: Jack Healy / New York Times: Utah Senate President J. Stuart Adams, who championed a huge data center beside the Great Salt Lake, lost his Republican primary on Tuesday after voter backlash — The upset of J. Stuart Adams represented one of the strongest examples of how the data center issue has affected elections.
